name: txpool_inspect
summary: Returns a summary of the transactions currently in the pool.
description:
The same `pending` and `queued` grouping as `txpool_content`, but each transaction is reduced to a single `recipient: value wei + gas x gasPrice gas` string, so the pool can be inspected without transferring it in full.

Both addresses here are bare hex without the `0x` prefix: the sender as the map key, and the recipient at the head of the summary string. The value and the gas price are decimal wei, not hex. A transaction that creates a contract has no recipient, so its summary begins with the empty string and a colon.

result.name: inspect
result.description: The pending and queued transactions, one summary string each

examples.name: inspectExample
examples.description: The same two transactions as the `txpool_content` example. The contract creation has no recipient, so its summary begins with a bare colon.
